facts.fact: Neela tips her six-pinch banana-leaf fold into the Company's noon-tree pot at the shelf and takes one even pinch like everyone else; the queen's riders take theirs from a green-waxed flat tin of crown resin Usha carried from the palace.
facts.why: needed because the beat has the guards take the crown's ration and the Company the noon trees'.

facts.fact: Neela missed the noon signal because the queen kept her in the sea room, standing at her elbow, for the whole hour on the day after the gun.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her explain the missed noon signal.

facts.fact: Two Company/garrison dead in the tower assault (Chami's cousin and a woman of Kalladi); seven hurt; all twenty-two queen's riders survive, three limping.
facts.why: needed to give the assault a cost; Kandan's tile left unwritten.

facts.fact: Usha has word that a crown column is a day and a half behind her riders on the road.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Thilak call the vote early on her report.

facts.fact: The Company's council summons is a great ram's horn kept at the cairn fire, one long bellow, distinct from Bhaskaran's gate code.
facts.why: needed for the council horn that interrupts Devan.
